parts.name: Base Compartment
parts.description: The base compartment of the pet carrier, made of durable ABS plastic, forms the main housing for the pet.

parts.name: Handle
parts.description: The handle of the pet carrier, made of polypropylene plastic, is attached to the top of the carrier.

parts.name: Lid
parts.description: The lid of the pet carrier, made of polycarbonate plastic, covers the top of the carrier.
